boards.title: Only Happens Here: 10 Traditions That Make No Sense Anywhere Else
boards.description: Ten documented Merrimack College traditions spanning the academic year, service, celebration and community gathering.

cards.title: Begin with the Block Party
cards.subtitle: Fall welcome-back tradition
cards.notes: Watch the Office of Student Involvement calendar at the start of fall term, then join the campus welcome-back celebration with the wider community.
cards.short_summary: A campus-wide kickoff for the new academic year.
cards.evidence_claim: Merrimack describes its Block Party as a welcome-back event for students, faculty, staff and families celebrating the new academic year.
cards.access_notes: Consult Merrimack's event calendar for the current date, location and attendance details.

cards.title: Open Homecoming with Macktoberfest
cards.subtitle: Merrimack’s signature fall festival
cards.notes: Look for Macktoberfest at Homecoming time and use the official event listing to confirm the year’s music, activities and family logistics.
cards.short_summary: A signature fall festival that launches Homecoming Weekend.
cards.evidence_claim: Merrimack identifies Macktoberfest as its signature fall festival and says it kicks off Homecoming Weekend.
cards.access_notes: Programming and location vary by year; verify details through Merrimack's official event calendar.

cards.title: Return for Homecoming Weekend
cards.subtitle: Annual Warrior-pride weekend
cards.notes: Check the published weekend schedule before visiting; it brings students, families, alumni, faculty, staff and friends together around campus events.
cards.evidence_claim: Merrimack calls its Homecoming, Reunion and Alumni Weekend tailgate experience an exciting annual tradition and invites the broader Merrimack community.
cards.source_title: Homecoming, Reunion & Alumni Weekend | Merrimack College
cards.access_notes: Review the current official schedule and any registration or parking instructions before attending.

cards.title: Serve through Mack Gives Back
cards.subtitle: Community-service tradition
cards.notes: Find the year’s service opportunities through Merrimack and choose a project that fits your schedule; participation centers on helping the surrounding community.
cards.short_summary: A long-running service tradition tied to Merrimack’s history.
cards.evidence_claim: Merrimack describes Mack Gives Back as a long-standing tradition in which its community coordinates service events, commemorating Veterans Day and St. Augustine’s birthday.
cards.source_title: Merrimack Continues Mack Gives Back Tradition, Despite COVID-19 Restrictions
cards.access_notes: Service sites and sign-up details change each year; follow the College's current announcements.

cards.title: Mark the season at Light & Hope
cards.subtitle: Holiday-season tree-lighting event
cards.notes: Plan for the first Thursday after Thanksgiving break and confirm the current program; the event centers on the campus tree lighting and winter activities.
cards.evidence_claim: Merrimack says Light & Hope occurs on the first Thursday after Thanksgiving break and marks the beginning of the holiday season with a tree lighting and winter festivities.
cards.access_notes: Check the official event calendar for the precise time, location and weather-related updates.

cards.title: Pause for Cram Jam
cards.subtitle: Finals-week late-night program
cards.notes: During finals week, look for the fall or spring edition in the official calendar and take a study break with the scheduled indoor games and breakfast food.
cards.short_summary: A finals-week study-break tradition held in both semesters.
cards.evidence_claim: Merrimack describes Cram Jam as a late-night finals-week program where students unwind with breakfast food and indoor games, in fall and spring.
cards.access_notes: The official listing does not publish a standing time; check the current finals-week event calendar.

cards.title: Follow Spring Weekend to its concert
cards.subtitle: End-of-semester event series
cards.notes: Check the announced program as spring approaches; Merrimack’s Office of Student Involvement closes the semester with large-scale events and a Spring Concert.
cards.short_summary: An end-of-semester series anchored by the Spring Concert.
cards.evidence_claim: Merrimack says Spring Weekend is a tradition packed with events and ending with a concert, while its student-involvement office hosts the semester-ending series.
cards.source_title: The Merrimack Bucket List | Merrimack College
cards.access_notes: Artist, venue, timing and entry details are announced separately; use Merrimack's current event calendar.

cards.title: Count down with 100 Days
cards.subtitle: Senior-year milestone celebration
cards.notes: If you are a senior, watch Office of Student Involvement announcements for the year’s gathering marking the beginning of the final stretch at Merrimack.
cards.short_summary: A senior milestone that begins the final 50-day campus journey.
cards.evidence_claim: Merrimack’s Office of Student Involvement says 100 Days marks the beginning of the last 50 days of seniors’ journey at Merrimack.
cards.access_notes: This is designated for seniors; confirm the current event details with the Office of Student Involvement.

cards.title: Close out with Senior Week
cards.subtitle: Senior-year series before Commencement
cards.notes: Eligible seniors can follow current College announcements for the week’s individual events, then choose activities that fit their plans before Commencement.
cards.short_summary: A week of senior events designed to close the Merrimack experience.
cards.evidence_claim: Merrimack describes Senior Week as a week of events for seniors to come together and make their last memories at the College.
cards.access_notes: Senior Week eligibility, schedule and any registration requirements are set annually.

cards.title: Join the conversation at Breaking Bread
cards.subtitle: Community meal and dialogue
cards.notes: Watch Intercultural Initiatives announcements and attend if registration is offered; the event pairs a shared meal with guided conversations on belonging and culture.
cards.short_summary: A newer Merrimack tradition of food, dialogue and belonging.
cards.evidence_claim: Merrimack reported that Breaking Bread was in its third year in 2025 and had become one of the College’s newest traditions.
cards.source_title: Merrimack Celebrates Community and Belonging at Breaking Bread
cards.access_notes: Current dates, location and RSVP requirements should be confirmed through Merrimack's official programming notices.
